annotations.text:
Palitra — Night 0B0B0B · Jet 333533 · Eggshell F2ECDD · Saffron F5CB5C · Satin gold CD9C20

Qanday qurilgan:

· Ikki to'q rang sahifani qavsga oladi: masthead va aloqa tasmasi Night kartalar. Ular orasida to'rt plitka Saffron → Satin gold zinasida — bitta ohang, to'rt pog'ona.

· Saffron faqat Night ustida: emblema, chip gliflari, kicker, slogan — logoning asl 'qora fonda tilla' ko'rinishi.

· Tilla plitkalarda matn Night va Jet. Tilla ustida tilla yozuv yo'q; Eggshell ustida mayda tilla matn ham yo'q (2.1:1) — u yerda tilla faqat bezak.

· Jet — plitkadagi tavsif matni va chip gradientining yorug' tomoni.

Kontrast (WCAG AA):

· Saffron / Night — 12.6:1
· Night / Saffron plitka — 15.8:1
· Jet / Satin gold (eng to'q plitka) — 4.9:1
· Jet / Eggshell — 10.4:1
· Eggshell 70% / Night — 8.2:1

Animatsiyalar o'zgarmadi: strelka, pillalar, emblema — faqat transform va opacity.
